title: Impact of SkillsFuture on Employability of Graduates above Age 40
what_it_is: Impact of SkillsFuture on Employability of Graduates above Age 40

sections.label: Retrenched PMETs aged 40 and above
sections.summary: About 5,000 retrenched local PMETs aged 40 and above in 2016, with one-third re-entering the same industry and over 6,000 finding jobs in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower of the number of university graduates aged 40 years and above in 2016 who had left their jobs or were retrenched in that year, how many have managed to secure employment thereafter in (i) the same industry they were in or (ii) a different industry respectively as a result of the SkillsFuture movement.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: There were about 5,000 retrenched local PMETs aged 40 and above in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: About one-third of those who subsequently found jobs re-entered the same industry, while the rest took up jobs in a different industry.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In 2017, more than 6,000 PMETs aged 40 and above found jobs through career matching services or programmes, such as the Professional Conversion Programmes (PCPs) and Career Support Programme (CSP), which provide training and wage support to bridge mismatches in skills or wage expectations.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This is an increase of almost 50% compared to 2016.

sections.label: Awareness of SkillsFuture schemes
sections.summary: Asking whether the Ministry has data on Singaporeans' awareness of SkillsFuture schemes and whether outreach plans exist.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Is there any data that the Ministry has to show the level of awareness and knowledge that Singaporeans have about the various schemes and programmes under SkillsFuture?

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: And are there plans to increase outreach or roadshows to inform and explain to Singaporeans that there are many different schemes and programmes under SkillsFuture that they can tap on?

sections.label: SkillsFuture initiatives for workforce
sections.summary: SkillsFuture launched an advisory for individuals and an initiative reaching out to businesses to help employees use available schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If they are already in the workforce, SkillsFuture has launched two major initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: One is an advisory for individuals; second, there is an initiative to reach out to businesses to help them, in turn, help their own employees make better use of the many schemes that are available under SkillsFuture.
